component.name: Vibemis
component.summary: Stream games from a Sunshine, Apollo or Vibepollo host

description.p: Vibemis is a Linux-focused game-streaming client, a fork of Moonlight Qt tuned to pair with Vibepollo and other Apollo/Sunshine hosts. It targets desktops, the Steam Deck, and handhelds running SteamOS Game Mode, letting you play games and use applications running on a remote PC as if they were local.

ul.li: Hardware accelerated video decoding with VAAPI, VDPAU, and Vulkan Video
H.264, HEVC, and AV1 codec support, including HDR
Up to 4K resolution and high refresh-rate streaming
Gamepad support with rumble and motion for up to 16 players
An in-stream Quick Menu for server commands and shortcuts, built for controller and Game Mode use
Vibepollo streaming presets tuned for handhelds
Pointer capture for games plus direct mouse control for remote desktop

screenshot.caption: Browsing paired hosts and available games
The in-stream Quick Menu overlay in Game Mode

description.p: Second stable release. Adds touchscreen passthrough, a Send Shift+Tab quick key, navigation sounds, the redesigned Help page, one-click Steam library launch, and an HDR tone-map toggle, plus security hardening (OTP secrets redacted from logs, clipboard sync now pins the paired certificate).
First stable Vibemis release: a Linux-focused Moonlight Qt fork tuned for Vibepollo/Apollo hosts, with the Game Mode Quick Menu overlay, Vibepollo presets, and SteamOS handheld polish.
